By default DPO uses **β = 0.1**, a **batch size of 64**, and the **RMSprop optimizer** with a **learning rate of 1e-6**. The learning rate is **warmed up linearly from 0 to 1e-6 over 150 steps**. For **TL;DR summarization**, the paper uses **β = 0.5** and keeps all other settings the same.

Source: Appendix B, "DPO Implementation Details and Hyperparameters." I can't give a page number because this HTML version of the paper has no page markers.
